entry.title: ‘The World Knows What Must Be Done’: New SDG Report Urges End to Wars and Greater Investment in People
entry.summary:

entry.title: Armed Conflict, Funding Cuts and Supply Chain Pressures Deepen Global Hunger Risks
entry.summary:
UNITED NATIONS, June 23 (IPS) - Armed conflict, economic shocks, and climate pressures are driving worsening food insecurity across many of the world’s most vulnerable regions, according to the latest Hunger Hotspots report outlook for June-November 2026, jointly released by the World Food Programme (WFP) and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).

entry.title: AI is Already Rewriting Reality for Billions of People– But It is Getting Women Wrong
entry.summary:
UNITED NATIONS, June 23 (IPS) - A study of 133 AI systems found that 44 per cent demonstrated gender bias and 26 per cent demonstrated both gender and racial bias. Yet only 51 per cent of marketers currently use human oversight to test AI-generated creative before release. Ahead of the United Nations Global Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence Governance from 6 – 7 July and AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva, Switzerland from 7-10 July, UN Women sets out what is at stake – and what must change – to build a gender-equal digital future.

Read the full story, “AI is Already Rewriting Reality for Billions of People– But It is Getting Women Wrong”, on globalissues.org →
